purpose.domain_detail: Marble inventory management demo application (IBM 'marbles' sample app), supporting CREate, UPDate, and DELete operations on marble color inventory via a CICS transaction MB10
purpose.summary: This is the MARBLE10 CICS transaction program from IBM's marbles demo application. It accepts user input specifying a verb (CRE/UPD/DEL) and marble color/inventory/cost, then performs the corresponding DB2 SQL operation (INSERT, UPDATE, or DELETE) on the EVENT.MARBLE table. It returns success or structured error codes (MARB001E–MARB005E) to the terminal.

notable_features: EXEC SQL with DB2 table declarations (EVENT.MARBLE, EVENT.COLOR)
REDEFINES for output area (success vs error)
No COPY statements or external CALLs
